revolutionist

(noun). Nhà cách mạng

Ex: It is only later, when the revolutionists have established themselves in power, that people see their obsessions were a mirage.

stare

(verb). nhìn chăm chăm, nhìn đằm đằm

Ex: They stared up at the hole in the ceiling.

stir

(verb). khích động, kích thích

Ex: He was stirred by the child's sad story.

sum

(noun). tổng số

Ex: This is the sum of my achievements so far.

uprising

(noun). cuộc nổi dậy

Ex: He led an armed uprising against the government.

validity

(noun). sự có căn cứ

Ex: We had doubts about the validity of their argument.

verbal

(adjective). thuộc lời nói

Ex: The job applicant must have good verbal skills.

aim

(noun). mục đích, mục tiêu

Ex: Our main aim is to provide affordable childcare.

appropriate

(adjective). Phù hợp

Ex: Is now an appropriate time to make a speech?

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

respond

(verb). phản ứng

Ex: How did they respond to the news?

satisfy

(verb). Làm thoả mãn

Ex: Nothing satisfies him—he's always complaining.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

meaningless

(adjective). vô nghĩa

Ex: The leaflet was full of meaningless information.

alarm

(noun). sự lo sợ

Ex: I felt a growing sense of alarm when he did not return that night.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

conventional

(adjective). thông thường, truyền thống

Ex: You can use a microwave or cook it in a conventional oven.

disapprove

(verb). không chấp thuận, phản đối

Ex: He strongly disapproved of the changes that had been made.

dull

(adjective). buồn tẻ, nhạt nhẽo

Ex: The countryside was flat, dull and uninteresting.

judge

(verb). đánh giá

Ex: You shouldn't judge her too harshly.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

reasonably

(adverb). hợp lý, chấp nhận được

Ex: The instructions are reasonably straightforward.

regard

(verb). xem như, coi là

Ex: Capital punishment was regarded as inhuman and immoral.

semantic

(adjective). Mang tính ngữ nghĩa

Ex: Another very important way in which a language grows is by semantic modification of existing words.

influence

(noun). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His early work shows the influence of Cézanne and Matisse.

accurately

(adverb). một cách chính xác

Ex: The article accurately reflects public opinion.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

mathematician

(noun). nhà toán học

Ex: So how do mathematicians solve these complicated differential equations?

precisely

(adverb). Chính xác, rõ ràng

Ex: They look precisely the same to me.

define

(verb). Định nghĩa

Ex: The term ‘mental illness’ is difficult to define.

incapable

(adjective). không đủ khả năng

Ex: The children seem to be totally incapable of working by themselves.

expert

(noun). Chuyên gia

Ex: Experts in the field of child psychology warn of the dangers of social media.

insight

(noun). cái nhìn sâu sắc

Ex: There are many valuable insights in her book.

intuitive

(adjective). thuộc về trực giác

Ex: He had an intuitive sense of what the reader wanted.

refer to

(verb). đề cập, nhắc đến

Ex: The victims were not referred to by name.

semanticist

(noun). nhà ngữ nghĩa học

Ex: Suppose that lawyers and semanticists learn how to come to clear conclusions about these things - I'm glad I'm just a simple phonetician.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

job market

(noun). thị trường việc làm

Ex: About 25,000 people enter the job market each month.

make sense

(verb). có nghĩa, hợp lý

Ex: This sentence doesn't make sense.

necessarily

(adverb). tất yếu, nhất thiết

Ex: Servants necessarily had close contact with their employers.

operationalism

(noun). thao tác luận

Ex: According to operationalism, STR changes the meanings of the concepts of space and time from the classical conception.

personnel

(noun). Nhân sự

Ex: There is a severe shortage of skilled personnel.

instance

(noun). ví dụ

Ex: The report highlights a number of instances of injustice.

accuracy

(noun). sự chính xác

Ex: They questioned the accuracy of the information in the file.

demonstrate

(verb). Trình bày, minh hoạ

Ex: New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.

disprove

(verb). bác bỏ

Ex: The theory has now been disproved.

in chains

(adverb). bị xiềng xích

Ex: The hostages were kept in chains for 23 hours a day.

statement

(noun). sự phát biểu, phát ngôn

Ex: He made a rather misleading statement.

individual

(noun). cá nhân

Ex: The competition is open to both teams and individuals.

personal

(adjective). thuộc về cá nhân, riêng tư

Ex: I'd like to talk to you about a personal matter.

worthy

(adjective). xứng đáng

Ex: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.

elicit

(verb). khêu ra, gợi ra

Ex: I could elicit no response from him.

endow

(verb). cấp cho

Ex: The state of Michigan has endowed three institutes to do research for industry.

symbolically

(adverb). một cách tượng trưng

Ex: Economically, it's not a big deal, but symbolically, it's enormous.

entertaining

(adjective). mang tính giải trí, thú vị

Ex: His books aren't particularly well-written, but they're always entertaining.

audience

(noun). Khán giả

Ex: The museum is trying to attract a wider audience.

blush

(verb). đỏ mặt

Ex: He blushed at the mention of her name.

induce

(verb). gây ra

Ex: Hearing loss is often induced by exposure to loud noise.

obscene

(adjective). tục tĩu

Ex: The book was declared obscene.

associate

(noun). bạn đồng liêu, người cùng cộng tác

Ex: A close associate of the author denied reports that she had cancer.

lasting

(adjective). kéo dài

Ex: Her words left a lasting impression on me.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

analyze

(verb). phân tích, đánh giá

Ex: He tried to analyze his feelings.

emphasize

(verb). Nhấn mạnh

Ex: His speech emphasized the importance of attracting industry to the town.

observe

(verb). Quan sát

Ex: I want you to observe all the details.

accept

(verb). chấp nhận

Ex: The judge refused to accept his evidence.

context

(noun). Bối cảnh

Ex: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

dollar bill

(noun). tờ tiền đô la

Ex: Donations from the private sector ranged anywhere from a 10 dollar bill to $1 million.

symbol

(noun). biểu tượng

Ex: The vase is decorated with religious symbols.

value

(noun). giá trị

Ex: For them, the house's main value lay in its quiet country location.
